name: Taipei

portalsFound.observation: NLSC (Ministry of the Interior National Land Surveying and Mapping Center) WFS list includes the cadastral layer WFS:CADAS_MERGE (地籍圖) alongside open layers such as WFS:VILLAGE_NLSC.
Spec page states the cadastral, e-map and land-use WFS are for approved government units; point/box/circle/polygon filters, max 1000m x 1000m; only the village boundary layer needs no application.
NLSC Cadastral Maps page; digital cadastral maps (DXF/SHP) are sold/issued via the Taiwan MAP Store with member login (secondary summary via search).
National open data portal, reachable; no anonymous cadastral parcel service located.
NLSC WMS capabilities list LANDSECT (land section outlines) and LandOffice, not parcel polygons.

requests.assessment: capabilities only; no parcel polygon layer seen among land-related names

remainingUncertainty: Cadastral WFS exists but is credentialed for government units; a municipal open-data feed (Taipei/New Taipei GIS) or a permitted application route was not verified. The queue centre point lies in New Taipei rather than Taipei City proper.
nextStep: Check Taipei and New Taipei open-data catalogs for a parcel (地籍) layer, and the NLSC application route/terms; recheck if Taiwan MAP Store offers anonymous GeoJSON.
